memory_candidates: A pending-splice pin trichotomy stated RELATIVE to the original path is not iterable; restating every clause about the path being spliced makes it both iterable and shorter, because the pending stretch forces a region start at or above the region start to BE it.

Write a decreasing-budget induction invariant with the spend ADDED ON THE RIGHT rather than subtracted from the budget: no truncated natural subtraction appears and each step's reproduction is one omega call.

An idle splice is a rigid index pullback in BOTH coordinates (idleSpliceCnt = cntAt composed with spliceIdx), unlike a pending splice, which is why HWZ's deletion type lemma applies to it unchanged and the iterate can expose the realized type at every position.

omega can fail with an internal 'Application type mismatch' in its own generated proof term on a large context with Exists.choose-headed terms; factoring the arithmetic into named lemmas over plain naturals is the fix, not a tactic change.

tpOf has no position-shift lemma, but tpOf_timeShift composed with tpOf_stabFree_eq_of_objAt_eq at a shifted history is the sanctioned conjugation for carrying a realized stab-free type across a translation of the path.
